description: Get current weather and a 7-day forecast for any city or coordinate before travel, logistics, events or field work. Returns current temperature, wind, humidity, pressure, cloud and precipitation, a 24-hour hourly outlook and daily min/max with precipitation, from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute's global model; city names are resolved via GeoNames (30k+ cities). Use when a plan depends on the weather in the coming days. $0.006 per call, USDC on Base (x402).
